title: CyberSteam Power Network
description: The modpack is set up for world exploration, automation with Create and Applied Energetic 2
body:
In this modpack, you have to explore dungeons, automate creation, and build your own network of factories from scratch

## Main idea - You explore the world and structures, collect resources, and gradually create a visually beautiful factory, automating everything with Create and tech mods, combining aesthetic mechanical engineering with digital storage and ease of exploration. ## Here are the modifications
